items:

The level of liquid in the tank must be above the minimum 
 level

The on-off valve in the suction from the tank must be

items:

text:
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
list I1, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
above title block.
This pump is used to transfer 
the alum from the storage tank to the daily tank
Technical Specifications:

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed 
Elhenawe, reviewed by eng. Hossam El-Din Mostafa, accepted by 
general manager eng. Magdy Okba, revised by 
MDEPC 
quality control 
eng. Magdy Hegazy, and approved by eng 
Ahmad Abd El-Meguid Sowan head sector of Nubaria PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general 
manager & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor
Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools and 
Equipment
Supports and thicknesses
Parallel v block
Hexagonal socket or elbowed wrenches (16,23,30 mm)
Wrenches (8,13,17 and 19 mm)
Puller 
 for pins 3,4,6,8 mm
Bearing extractor
Pair 
 of levers
Monkey 
 wrench
Hammer
Rubber 
 hummer
Twist 
 drill 3,4,6,8 mm
Vernier slide gauge
Emery 
 cloth
Surface gauge
Work to be carried out
Pump in operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and 
 power
Check the noise of the Pump.
Pump out of operation
Check the pump and piping for 
 leaks
Check the fixation
Check alignment
Starting 
 the Pump
Before starting the pump, the 
 following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting it 
 is clockwise and adjust if needed
The level of liquid in the tank must be above the minimum 
 level
The on-off valve in the suction from the tank must be 
 completely opened while the air discharge valve closed after complete priming
The control valve in delivery must be partially opened
Attendance and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be 
checked:
Following the indication of the flow - meter and manometer 
 installed adjusted to control valve on the plant delivery until the flow rate 
 and deliver head reach the design value if necessary and adjusted the bypass 
 flow rate
Check of flow rate delivery head and absorbed power
Check the water leakage of pump
Check the pump pressure
